recent_deploys.change_summary: Enabled preload of larger recommendation model artifact on startup

context.slack_context: Platform team: We only touched the image-cache daemon today; app teams report broad latency after autoscaler events.

ground_truth.root_cause: A kube-system image-cache daemon update started preloading a 3.2Gi artifact per node as BestEffort QoS, causing node memory pressure and eviction storms that degraded checkout-svc latency.
contributing_factors: autoscaler added nodes that immediately ran memory-heavy preload
BestEffort daemon was not constrained by memory requests/limits
ground_truth.correct_action: Roll back the image-cache daemon change or add strict memory requests/limits, then drain impacted nodes and verify evictions return to baseline.
